sentences.text:
Against Ext.P6 order passed by the District Collector under the Kerala Land Conservancy Act,
directing an eviction of the petitioners from the property, the petitioners have preferred Ext.P7 revision petition before the 1st respondent.

The limited prayer of the petitioners in this writ petition is for a direction to the 1 st respondent to consider and pass orders on the revision petition, after hearing him and to keep in abeyance Ext.P6 order, in the meanwhile.
2. I have heard the learned counsel appearing for the petitioners as also the learned Government Pleader appearing for the respondents.

On a consideration of the facts and circumstances of the case as also the submissions made across the bar, I dispose the writ petition with a direction to the 1st respondent to consider and pass orders on Ext.P6 revision petition preferred by the petitioners, within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment, after hearing the petitioners and others likely to be affected by orders to be passed by the 1st respondent.

It is made clear that till such time as orders are passed by the 1st respondent as directed and the order communicated to the petitioners, coercive steps pursuant to Ext.P6 order shall be kept in abeyance.
The petitioners shall produce a copy of the writ petition together with a copy of this judgment before the 1 st respondent for further action.

Sd/-
